elements.element: Transition assistance provided on expiry or termination
elements.evidence: Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Contractor shall (i) ... provide reasonable transition assistance

elements.element: Transition assistance available for up to 6 months
Return of Customer Data within 30 days of expiry/termination
elements.evidence: within thirty (30) days of such expiry or termination, return to Company all Company data

elements.element: Return in a standard machine-readable format
elements.evidence: in a commonly used, machine-readable format" — machine-readable is express but the format is qualified as "commonly used" rather than a standard format
(iii) thereafter delete all such data, Works and Confidential Information from its systems
certify such deletion to Company in writing

elements.element: At least 90 days of transition assistance
elements.evidence: transition assistance for up to six (6) months
within thirty (30) days of such expiry or termination, return to Company all Company data

reasons: The insertion supplies a complete wind-down mechanic where none existed: 6 months of assistance at then-current rates, 30-day return running from expiry/termination (not from a later request), deletion after return, and written certification.

The only shortfall against the locked preferred target is the format wording: the clause says "commonly used, machine-readable format" rather than a standard machine-readable format. Change "commonly used" to "standard" to close the preferred position.
The "at Company's request" condition attaches only to transition assistance and does not qualify the mandatory data-return, deletion, or certification duties, so the recurring boundary is respected.
Fallback (90 days assistance; 30-day export) is fully satisfied, so the clause is acceptable as drafted; the format wording is a rationale note rather than a material deviation.

Minimal and intent-preserving: a single new subsection (c) is added, no existing sentence is altered, and no undefined term or contradiction is introduced ("Works" and "Confidential Information" are existing Agreement concepts).
